name: Krea
summary: AI image, video and 3D generation and editing platform with 100+ models, a realtime canvas and LoRA training.
description: Web platform for generating and editing images, video and 3D with 100+ hosted AI models (Flux, Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Imagen and Krea's own models) from one interface, including a realtime canvas where images appear as you type or draw, upscaling, background removal, lipsync and motion transfer. Users can train custom LoRA models in the browser and chain models with a node-based workflow editor that publishes mini-apps; agent skills, an MCP server, an API and a ChatGPT plugin connect it to AI assistants. Free tier with daily compute credits; paid plans from $7/month.
contains: 100+ AI models in one interface, new models added on launch day
free tier: 100 units/day, no credit card required
paid plans from $7/month with commercial license; enterprise plans
realtime canvas: images appear as you type or draw (Realtime 14B)
custom LoRA finetuning for image and video, done in the browser
node-based workflow editor; workflows publishable as mini-apps
tools: upscaling, background remover, lipsync, motion transfer, 3D, video
API, MCP server and ChatGPT plugin; agent skills like faceless video
